name: Sheraton Miyako Hotel Tokyo
accessSummary: Shirokanedai Station (Tokyo Metro Namboku Line / Toei Mita Line) Exit 2: about 4 min walk / Shirokane-Takanawa Station Exit 1: about 5 min walk / Free hotel shuttle bus from JR Meguro Station East Exit (every 15 minutes)

rooms.name: Daigo (Entire Room)
rooms.note: Can be divided into 2 (West and East). Simultaneous interpretation equipment available. Used together with Saga, which faces it, a party for 1,000 guests is possible.

rooms.name: Daigo West
rooms.note: A section of Daigo. Theater capacity is 500 on the official website's banquet room page and 480 in the digital pamphlet (as of May 2026).

rooms.name: Saga (Entire Room)
rooms.note: Can be divided into 3 (East, Middle, West). The top of the banquet room page gives a maximum capacity of 300, while the theater figure in the table is 360.

rooms.name: Saga Middle
rooms.note: Area is from the digital pamphlet (as of May 2026).

rooms.name: Magnolia
rooms.note: Has windows, view of the Japanese garden (B1F). Maximum capacity 200.

rooms.name: Ise
rooms.note: Same area and capacity as Shima. The banquet room page lists them as "Ise & Shima": 31㎡, 12 people.

rooms.name: Shima
rooms.note: Same area and capacity as Ise. From the table in the digital pamphlet (as of May 2026).

ops.parking: The parking lot has 140 spaces with a height limit of 2.1 m. Large buses can park (the driver is required to stay at the hotel) (as of May 2026).
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Café California (1F), Chinese Restaurant Shisen (1F), Lobby Bar & Lounge Bamboo (1F), Sushi Shirokane Saeki (B1F), Teppanyaki Shirokane (B1F), Chef's Room Platinum (B1F) and M Bar (B1F) (as of May 2026).
